method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reconstruction of the induction step for the universal quantifier rule, direct substitution of the stated identity for B into the final conclusion, and exact structural comparison after the documented OLAXD-002 and OLAXD-003 projections. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: The quantified extension of the proof-theoretic Deduction Theorem, including the universal quantifier-rule induction case and the existential case left as an exercise.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The quantified Deduction Theorem says that if Gamma together with A derives B, then Gamma derives A-implies-B.
samples.checks: The theorem direction, union with singleton A, derivability symbols, implication and label are exact; the title retains the established proof-theoretic Deduction Theorem term.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Induct again on the length of the derivation of B from Gamma union {A}; the basis is exactly the basis already proved for the earlier Deduction Theorem.
samples.checks: The induction measure, source and target of the derivation, and the cited theorem reference are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If the last inference is modus ponens, reuse the earlier argument. For the universal quantifier rule, write B as C-implies-forall x D(x), use the earlier C-implies-D(a) line and the induction hypothesis, convert A-implies-(C-implies-D(a)) into (A-and-C)-implies-D(a), apply the quantifier rule under the unchanged eigenvariable condition, and convert back to A-implies-B.
samples.checks: Every sequent, formula metavariable, quantifier, occurrence restriction, inference order and reference is preserved. OLAXD-002 supplies one missing outer parenthesis in the displayed transformation theorem; OLAXD-003 restores A-implies in the final conclusion.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The corresponding quantifier-rule case where B has existential-D-implies-C form is left as the exercise that asks the reader to complete the theorem proof.
samples.checks: The existential formula, rule macro, exercise status and four-part theorem reference remain exact.

source_observations: OLAXD-002 documents a deterministically missing outer right parenthesis in the second displayed transformation theorem. The Marathi target supplies one parenthesis and carries an adjacent stable reader note; frozen English bytes remain unchanged.

OLAXD-003 documents that the source's final prose conclusion drops the A-implies operator established by the preceding line and required by the theorem. The Marathi target restores A-implies-B and carries an adjacent stable reader note; frozen English bytes remain unchanged.
The eigenvariable restriction explicitly excludes a from C, A and Gamma, allowing the quantifier-rule step after conjunction with A.
All formulas, macros, tokens, labels, identifiers and reference options match after the two documented projections.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
आयगेन चराची अट remains a provisional compositional proof-theory label under T179.
The existential quantifier-rule case is intentionally left without a proof in the source.
